title: Copyright Leakage Detection in AI Generated Videos
title_zh: AI生成视频中的版权泄露检测

paragraphs.en: 总结：该研究提出视频版权泄露检测新基准与对比检索工具集，检测准确率达99.6%，数据与代码均已开源。 Video generation models can create realistic-looking video footage from images and text prompts. Some of the recent advances have raised concerns about the reproduction of copyrighted visual content. However, copyright leakage detection in generated videos remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce a new benchmark data set for copyright leakage detection, comprising 50 copyrighted concepts, each with 5 images. For each concept, we have 5 videos created using the image+prompt video generation model and the prompt-only video generation model. Following that, we develop an AI toolset based on a contrastive retrieval framework that formulates copyright leakage detection as a video-to-image retrieval problem by matching aggregated video frame embeddings against a database of copyrighted image embeddings. Our method uses a single similarity threshold and retrieves the most similar copyrighted reference as supporting evidence. We conducted experiments showing strong retrieval and detection performance, achieving 99.6\% detection accuracy with only a single false negative. These results show the effectiveness of the retrieval-based method for scalable and explainable copyright leakage detection in AI-generated videos. Data can be accessed publicly from https://zenodo.org/records/21386117 and the source code for this project is publicly available at https://github.com/Shaif95/video-cp-Leakage.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：该研究提出视频版权泄露检测新基准与对比检索工具集，检测准确率达99.6%，数据与代码均已开源。视频生成模型能够根据图像和文本提示生成看起来逼真的视频片段。 近期的一些进展引发了人们对受版权保护的视觉内容被复制的担忧。 然而，生成视频中的版权泄露检测在很大程度上仍未被探索。 在本文中，我们引入了一个用于版权泄露检测的新基准数据集，包含50个受版权保护的概念，每个概念配有5张图像。 对于每个概念，我们使用图像+提示视频生成模型和仅提示视频生成模型各生成了5个视频。 在此基础上，我们开发了一个基于对比检索框架的AI工具集，将版权泄露检测表述为一个视频到图像的检索问题，通过将聚合的视频帧嵌入与受版权保护的图像嵌入数据库进行匹配来实现。 我们的方法使用单一相似度阈值，并检索出最相似的受版权保护参考作为支持证据。 我们进行的实验展示了强大的检索和检测性能，实现了99.6%的检测准确率，仅有1个假阴性。 这些结果表明了基于检索的方法在AI生成视频的可扩展且可解释的版权泄露检测方面的有效性。 数据可从 https://zenodo.org/records/21386117 公开获取，该项目的源代码可在 https://github.com/Shaif95/video-cp-Leakage 公开获取。
